primitives.name: Sequential Gate Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Gate n+1 does not open unless gate n returned PASS, FAIL, or TURNED_AWAY with a reason.
primitives.assumptions: Each gate must return explicit terminal state before proceeding.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Undefined behavior if prior gate fails to emit terminal state.

primitives.assumptions: Equation sets are represented as shingles; similarity computed via MinHash.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Null case when denominator is zero or shingle sets are empty.

primitives.name: Equation Terminal State Emission
primitives.verbatim_quote: Each gate emits one JSON object, then the equations that gate required, then stops.
primitives.assumptions: All required equations must be emitted in sequence before termination.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Truncation or omission results in REFUSED_TRUNCATED or UNOPENED.

layer2.mapping: Analogous to GSI's final belief state emission, where all prior evidence is aggregated into a single probabilistic conclusion.
layer2.telemetry: JSON object containing parsed equations and their validation status.
